note: v8: Nick's Avalanche order on NEAR. Landing (v7 opening + comparison) -> Merchant -> app -> Aubelle as a buyer x4 (pop-up) -> privacy note -> repay, merchant, payouts. Numbers are filled from the live ledger.

lines.text: Your money is in stocks, but the shop wants dollars. So you sell first, and wait.
lines.say: Your money is in stocks, but the shop wants dollars. So you sell first, and wait.

lines.text: Noren lets a shop take stablecoins, stocks, or credit against your stocks. Live on NEAR.
lines.say: Noh-ren lets a shop take stablecoins, stocks, or credit against your stocks. Live on Near.

lines.text: Pay-later apps like Klarna and Affirm lend you their money, after a credit check. Noren lends against stock you already own, by rules in a contract on NEAR.
lines.say: Pay-later apps like Klarna and Affirm lend you their money, after a credit check. Noh-ren lends against stock you already own, by rules in a contract on Near.

lines.text: Here's the honest side by side, with sources: no credit check, ten percent a year on what you draw, and the shop gets the full amount.
lines.say: Here's the honest side by side, with sources: no credit check, ten percent a year on what you draw, and the shop gets the full amount.

lines.text: First, the shop. Aubelle, a dress boutique, signs in to Noren Merchant with a NEAR wallet. No transaction, no account.
lines.say: First, the shop. Oh-bell, a dress boutique, signs in to Noh-ren Merchant with a Near wallet. No transaction, no account.

lines.text: It names the store, and the NEAR account that gets paid.
lines.say: It names the store, and the Near account that gets paid.

lines.text: A first payment link. Then API keys: the secret is shown once, so it's covered here.
lines.say: A first payment link. Then A P I keys: the secret is shown once, so it's covered here.

lines.text: Last, Aubelle connects its online shop. That's how a shop starts taking Noren.
lines.say: Last, Oh-bell connects its online shop. That's how a shop starts taking Noh-ren.

lines.text: Now the customer. Alice opens the Noren app: her dollars, her bitcoin and her credit, all read live from NEAR.
lines.say: Now the customer. Alice opens the Noh-ren app: her dollars, her bitcoin and her credit, all read live from Near.

lines.text: On testnet, she gets funds right in the app: two hundred test USDC. Before anything is signed, the test wallet shows what she's approving. She approves.
lines.say: On testnet, she gets funds right in the app: two hundred test U S D C. Before anything is signed, the test wallet shows what she's approving. She approves.

lines.text: The explorer confirms it: success.
lines.say: The explorer confirms it: success.

lines.text: US stocks are closed today, so she locks test bitcoin instead. Stocks work the same way. The wallet shows the lock, and she approves.
lines.say: US stocks are closed today, so she locks test bitcoin instead. Stocks work the same way. The wallet shows the lock, and she approves.

lines.text: Her credit limit appears: about a hundred and eighteen dollars, half the bitcoin's value.
lines.say: Her credit limit appears: about a hundred and eighteen dollars, half the bitcoin's value.

lines.text: She locks a little more, and the limit grows to about two hundred and thirty-five.
lines.say: She locks a little more, and the limit grows to about two hundred and thirty-five.

lines.text: The bitcoin stays hers. It's locked, not sold.
lines.say: The bitcoin stays hers. It's locked, not sold.

lines.text: Now the shop, as any buyer sees it. She picks the Rosalie knit, size small, adds it to her bag, and checks out.
lines.say: Now the shop, as any buyer sees it. She picks the Rosalie knit, size small, adds it to her bag, and checks out.

lines.text: Pay with Noren opens Noren's checkout, right over the shop.
lines.say: Pay with Noh-ren opens Noh-ren's checkout, right over the shop.

lines.text: Four ways to pay. With stocks: the last Tesla price is from Friday, so the market is closed. With USDC. Pay later. Or pay in three.
lines.say: Four ways to pay. With stocks: the last Tesla price is from Friday, so the market is closed. With U S D C. Pay later. Or pay in three.

lines.text: She splits it in three. The wallet shows the schedule, and she approves.
lines.say: She splits it in three. The wallet shows the schedule, and she approves.

lines.text: The first part pays Aubelle now, from her credit line. The other two are due in thirty and sixty days.
lines.say: The first part pays Oh-bell now, from her credit line. The other two are due in thirty and sixty days.

lines.text: Back at Aubelle, the order shows partly paid.
lines.say: Back at Oh-bell, the order shows partly paid.

lines.text: On the explorer: the schedule, then the first draw.
lines.say: On the explorer: the schedule, then the first draw.

lines.text: Next, the Amélie gingham. Same bag, same pop-up. This time, she pays later.
lines.say: Next, the Amelie gingham. Same bag, same pop-up. This time, she pays later.

lines.text: Aubelle gets all hundred and forty-eight dollars now, from her credit line. Her bitcoin stays locked.
lines.say: Oh-bell gets all hundred and forty-eight dollars now, from her credit line. Her bitcoin stays locked.

lines.text: Paid, and the shop has the order.
lines.say: Paid, and the shop has the order.

lines.text: One honest note: on NEAR, these payments are public. Who paid, who got paid, and how much. Private checkout isn't built on NEAR.
lines.say: One honest note: on Near, these payments are public. Who paid, who got paid, and how much. Private checkout isn't built on Near.

lines.text: A third dress. Pay with stocks. Tesla's price is stale, so she picks test bitcoin, at a fresh, signed price.
lines.say: A third dress. Pay with stocks. Tesla's price is stale, so she picks test bitcoin, at a fresh, signed price.

lines.text: Noren sells just enough bitcoin, and Aubelle gets a hundred and fifty-eight dollars in USDC.
lines.say: Noh-ren sells just enough bitcoin, and Oh-bell gets a hundred and fifty-eight dollars in U S D C.

lines.text: Riya, another shopper, has test USDC and no NEAR at all. She pays for the Amélie in USDC.
lines.say: Riya, another shopper, has test U S D C and no Near at all. She pays for the Amelie in U S D C.

lines.text: The checkout sees she has no NEAR, and says it plainly: no NEAR needed for gas.
lines.say: The checkout sees she has no Near, and says it plainly: no Near needed for gas.

lines.text: The wallet shows it too: the relayer pays the gas. She approves.
lines.say: The wallet shows it too: the relayer pays the gas. She approves.

lines.text: On the explorer, Noren's relayer is the signer. Her payment rides inside, as a delegate action.
lines.say: On the explorer, Noh-ren's relayer is the signer. Her payment rides inside, as a delegate action.

lines.text: Back in the app, Alice repays her credit: two hundred and seven dollars, interest included. She approves, and her debt goes to zero.
lines.say: Back in the app, Alice repays her credit: two hundred and seven dollars, interest included. She approves, and her debt goes to zero.

lines.text: Aubelle sees every order in Noren Merchant: today's demo runs, paid in three, later, in bitcoin and in gasless USDC, and the ones left unpaid.
lines.say: Oh-bell sees every order in Noh-ren Merchant: today's demo runs, paid in three, later, in bitcoin and in gasless U S D C, and the ones left unpaid.

lines.text: Payouts need no batch: each payment lands in the shop's own NEAR account, as USDC.
lines.say: Payouts need no batch: each payment lands in the shop's own Near account, as U S D C.

lines.text: Noren. Keep your coins, and still buy the thing.
lines.say: Noh-ren. Keep your coins, and still buy the thing.
